load_svmlight_file: load a single dataset file in svmlight/libsvm format into a sparse CSR matrix and target array
load_svmlight_files: load multiple svmlight/libsvm files into a single concatenated dataset with consistent feature dimensions
dump_svmlight_file: dump a dataset as sparse matrix and target array into svmlight/libsvm file format
load_svmlight_file_multilabel: load a svmlight file with multilabel targets as a list of tuples
dump_svmlight_file_query_id: dump a dataset with query_id array for pairwise preference constraints in learning to rank
